[![GaryRagle](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/a/ad/GaryRagle.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/200?cb=20211003085816)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/a/ad/GaryRagle.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20211003085816)
**Gary Ragle** is an American automotive designer who was one of the six designers who participated in the [Hot Wheels Designers Challenge](/wiki/Designers_Challenge); he represented [Mitsubishi Motors](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mitsubishi_Motors), for he was Senior Designer for Mitsubishi Motors R&D of America, by designing the [Mitsubishi Double Shotz](/wiki/Mitsubishi_Double_Shotz) for said series. Ragle joined Mitsubishi R&D initially as an intern in 2002 before transitioning to a full-time role and leaving in 2009, and is one of two Designers Challenge designers with ties to Hot Wheels before going onto professional design; he interned at Mattel in 2000. He currently runs his own design firm, Ragle Design, as well as designing for Hydra Design Labs, an automotive design consultancy.
